{{Quote|We anticipate his next attack will be in the Hexus system. Go there and reinforce Admiral Aldanna's blockade.|[[Mace Windu/Legends|Mace Windu]], telling Anakin Skywalker about Tofen Vane's next target|<ref name="Hero2" />}}
'''Aldanna''' was a [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Republic]] [[Admiral/Legends|admiral]] active during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]]. In [[22 BBY/Legends|22 BBY]], the Republic attempted to establish [[Blockade/Legends|blockades]] of neutral [[Planet/Legends|worlds]] that provided military aid to the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Independent Systems]]. As part of this strategy, three [[Venator-class Star Destroyer/Legends|''Venator''-class Star Destroyers]] under Aldanna's command were dispatched to blockade the [[Hexus system/Legends|Hexus system]]. Aldanna's forces were [[Battle of the Hexus system|attacked]] by a [[Squadron/Legends|squadron]] of Confederate [[Starfighter/Legends|starfighters]] led by the [[Ace/Legends|ace]] [[Pilot/Legends|pilot]] [[Tofen Vane/Legends|Tofen Vane]], but the Republic ultimately won the battle.

==Biography==
[[File:Battle_in_the_Hexus_system.jpg|thumb|right|270px|Aldanna's forces are attacked by the Valahari.]]
Aldanna was an [[Admiral/Legends|admiral]] in the [[Republic Navy/Legends|Republic Navy]] during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]].<ref name="Hero2" /> In [[22 BBY/Legends|22 BBY]],<ref name="HotC date">{{FactFile2014|8|21 BBY 1-2|The Second Battle of Geonosis}} dates "[[Landing at Point Rain]]" to [[22 BBY/Legends|22 BBY]]. Since ''[[Star Wars: The Ultimate Visual Guide: Updated and Expanded]]'' places the events of ''[[Star Wars: The Clone Wars: Hero of the Confederacy]]'' prior to "Landing at Point Rain," it can be concluded that ''Hero of the Confederacy'' also takes place in 22 [[Galactic Standard Calendar|BBY]].</ref> the first [[Standard year/Legends|year]] of the war,<ref name="NEC">''[[The New Essential Chronology]]''</ref> the people of the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Valahari/Legends|Valahari]] joined the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Independent Systems]], and the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]], in response, established [[Blockade/Legends|blockades]] of neutral worlds that supplied military aid to the Confederacy. Aldanna was placed in charge of a blockade of the [[Hexus system/Legends|Hexus system]] and was given command of three [[Venator-class Star Destroyer/Legends|''Venator''-class Star Destroyers]]. Soon, however, the Valahari, led by the [[Ace/Legends|ace]] [[Pilot/Legends|pilot]] [[Tofen Vane/Legends|Tofen Vane]], began attacking the Republic blockades, crushing all resistance.<ref name="Hero2" />

When the [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order]] learned that Vane's next target would be Aldanna's blockade, they sent [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knight]] [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Anakin Skywalker]] to help the Admiral withstand the attack. When Vane arrived, Skywalker [[Battle of the Hexus system|engaged]] him in a [[Starfighter combat/Legends|dogfight]] while Vane's [[Squadron/Legends|squadron]], [[Tofen's Raiders/Legends|Tofen's Raiders]], attacked Aldanna's forces. Vane managed to best Skywalker and shoot him down, but ultimately spared his life. Aldanna's [[Starship/Legends|ships]] received major damage, but the timely arrival of Republic reinforcements led by Admiral [[Wullf Yularen/Legends|Wullf Yularen]] forced the Valahari to retreat.<ref name="Hero2" />

==Behind the scenes==
Aldanna was mentioned in the [[The Clone Wars 11|eleventh issue]] of the [[Star Wars: The Clone Wars (comic series)|''Star Wars: The Clone Wars'']] [[Star Wars comic books|comic-book]] series written by [[Henry Gilroy]] and [[Steven Melching]] and published by [[Dark Horse Comics]]<ref name="Hero2" /> on [[December 9]], [[2009]].<ref name="Dark Horse">{{DarkHorse|url=Comics/16-242/Star-Wars-The-Clone-Wars-11----Hero-of-the-Confederacy-part-2|text=Star Wars: The Clone Wars #11 &mdash; Hero of the Confederacy part 2}}</ref>
